notes: Verdict rationale: 'defunct' would be factually wrong (Discord live with 36 users online today; LinkedIn page live), but 'relocated' would overstate - no live official location hosts the FARS content (papers, code, deployment archive, blog), and nothing announces a move. The web platform outage began somewhere in the 7-week window 2026-06-23 to 2026-08-13 and could in principle be a transient/abandoned-server state; DNS still points at the Alibaba Cloud IP.

What is missing to resolve to defunct-vs-relocated: (1) current state of x.com/AnalemmaAI - the most likely place for an outage/relocation notice - unfetchable from here (HTTP 402; an authenticated X session or the user's browser would answer this in one look); (2) any statement inside the Discord server (invite is valid but reading content requires joining); (3) ACRA registry status of the Singapore entity (aggregator pages blocked).
